[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
Tired of throwing away all that trash you fish up? The Trash Recycler machine gives you a second chance at fortune. Simply insert any trash item and wait for the machine to process it into a random valuable item.

This mod adds a craftable machine that accepts all trash items including regular trash, broken CDs, driftwood, broken glasses, and soggy newspapers. After a short processing time, the machine will output a random item based on your configured value settings.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41586/41586-1769223581-502337862.gif[/img]﻿[/center]


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Craftable Trash Recycler machine
[*]Accepts all trash items from fishing and other sources
[*]Outputs random items based on configurable maximum value
[*]Adjustable processing time
[*]Full Generic Mod Config Menu integration for easy customization
[/list]

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41586/41586-1769223406-115046998.png[/img]﻿[/center][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41586/41586-1769223627-1894059742.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Craft the Trash Recycler 
[*]Place the machine anywhere on your farm
[*]Right-click the machine while holding any trash item
[*]Wait for the processing time to complete
[*]Right-click again to collect your random treasure
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41586/41586-1769223627-95815815.png[/img]﻿[size=5][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can customize the following settings:

[list]
[*][b]Max Item Value:[/b] Controls the maximum value of items the machine can output (default: 500g)
[*][b]Process Time:[/b] How many in-game hours it takes to process trash (default: 0.5 hours)
[/list]

[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher
